boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, documentable destinations on corridors immediately around Catholic University’s Brookland campus.

cards.title: Connect to the Red Line
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Use the station at 890 Monroe Street NE for Red Line rail service; WMATA also lists bike racks, lockers, and bikesharing here.
cards.short_summary: A transit anchor at the Monroe Street edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: WMATA lists Brookland-CUA at 890 Monroe St NE with Red Line service, bike racks, lockers, and bikesharing.
cards.access_notes: Check WMATA service status before traveling.

cards.title: Browse a five-block campus-adjacent market
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Walk the five-block redevelopment across Michigan Avenue from campus, which includes restaurants, art venues, events, and the University bookstore.
cards.short_summary: A named mixed-use destination directly across from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University states that Monroe Street Market sits across Michigan Avenue from campus, spans five blocks, and includes restaurants, art venues, events, and its official bookstore.
cards.source_title: Destination: Brookland | Catholic University of America
cards.access_notes: Retail, event, and venue access varies by tenant and program.

cards.title: Follow the 27-studio promenade
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Start at 716 Monroe Street NE and browse the pedestrian promenade’s 27 local artist and maker studios; individual studio schedules vary.
cards.short_summary: A compact outdoor arts corridor with working studios.
cards.evidence_claim: Brookland Arts Walk identifies itself as a pedestrian promenade of 27 art studios at 716 Monroe St NE.
cards.access_notes: Many studios are open Saturdays, but confirm an individual studio’s hours before visiting.

cards.title: Check the programmed plaza
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Look for current Monroe Street Market programming at Cornerstone Plaza, the named plaza in front of Busboys and Poets at 625 Monroe Street NE.
cards.short_summary: A named market plaza used as an event location.
cards.evidence_claim: Monroe Street Market lists Cornerstone Plaza, in front of Busboys and Poets, at 625 Monroe St NE among its event locations.
cards.access_notes: Check the market’s event listings for scheduled public programming.

cards.title: See a local dance performance
cards.subtitle: 8th Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Check Dance Place’s current performance and class calendar at 3225 8th Street NE; its office is open weekdays from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit dance center two blocks from Brookland-CUA Metro.
cards.evidence_claim: Dance Place describes itself as a nonprofit dance center offering performances and classes at 3225 8th Street NE.
cards.access_notes: Performance tickets and class registration may be required; check the current calendar.

cards.title: Use the pool, courts, or walking track
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue NE corridor
cards.notes: Visit the city recreation center at 1100 Michigan Avenue NE for its indoor pool, gym, courts, playground, and outdoor walking track.
cards.short_summary: A public recreation complex on Michigan Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: DC DPR lists Turkey Thicket’s indoor pool, gym, fitness center, courts, playground, baseball field, and walking track at 1100 Michigan Ave NE.
cards.source_title: Turkey Thicket Recreation Center | DC Department of Parks and Recreation
cards.access_notes: The recreation center lists Monday–Friday 6 a.m.–9 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; pool access rules may differ.

cards.title: Pick up groceries on 12th Street
cards.subtitle: 12th Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Use the Brookland grocery store at 3809 12th Street NE for a practical food-and-essentials stop; the store lists daily 7 a.m.–10 p.m. hours.
cards.short_summary: A named grocery destination on the 12th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Yes! Organic Market lists its Brookland location at 3809 12th St NE and states it is open 7 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Contact Yes! Organic Market | Washington, DC
cards.access_notes: Store purchase is required; confirm holiday hours directly with the market.

cards.entity_name: Basilica of the National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception
cards.title: Take the self-guided church tour
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue NE corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Basilica at 400 Michigan Avenue NE and use its virtual tour as a preview of the Great Upper Church, Crypt Church, Memorial Hall, and chapels.
cards.short_summary: A major sacred-art destination on the Michigan Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Basilica’s visitor page lists 400 Michigan Avenue NE and a self-guided virtual tour of the Great Upper Church, Crypt Church, Memorial Hall, and chapels.
cards.source_title: Tour | National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception
cards.access_notes: Guided tours require reservations; check the Basilica’s visitor information before arrival.

cards.entity_name: Franciscan Monastery of the Holy Land in America
cards.title: Walk the garden trail
cards.subtitle: Quincy Street NE corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daytime garden walk at 1400 Quincy Street NE, then reserve ahead if you want a guided church tour and access to lower-level sites.
cards.short_summary: Gardens and Holy Land shrine replicas on Quincy Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Monastery states that its gardens are open daily 9 a.m.–4:45 p.m. and that self-guided Upper Church and garden visits are available Monday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Visit the Franciscan Monastery of the Holy Land
cards.access_notes: Gardens are open daily 9 a.m.–4:45 p.m.; guided tours are scheduled separately and should be reserved in advance.

cards.entity_name: Saint John Paul II National Shrine
cards.title: Plan a pilgrimage stop
cards.subtitle: Harewood Road NE corridor
cards.notes: Visit the shrine at 3900 Harewood Road NE for its scheduled Masses, temporary exhibits, and shrine programming; review the day’s calendar first.
cards.short_summary: A named pilgrimage destination beside the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint John Paul II National Shrine lists its address as 3900 Harewood Rd NE, states it is open every day, and directs visitors to updates on events, Masses, and temporary exhibits.
cards.source_title: Support | Saint John Paul II National Shrine
cards.access_notes: The shrine states it is open every day; consult its current visitor and event information before going.
